examples.title: CI gate: reproducible, no encryption, safe names

description: Read-only archive report in ONE call: size, entry / file / directory counts, Zip64, comment, compressed vs uncompressed totals, per-method counts, encrypted / symlink / data-descriptor / Zip64 / cp437 / duplicate / unsafe-name counts, date range, a `determinism` verdict (epoch timestamps + canonical order + UTF-8 flags ⇒ reproducible; `canonicalLayout` = no data descriptors) and every engine diagnostic (prepended SFX data, name mismatches, …). Opens EAGERLY by default: every entry's real extent is checked up front — overlapping entries, entries reaching into the central directory or past EOF, and Zip64 spoofing — and refused with their ZIP_* code rather than summarised (a method / CRC / size divergence between central and local headers is caught by verify_zip and on read, not here). `check:[…]` / `assert:{…}` turn it into a CI gate → `checks[]` + `checksPassed`. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:[…]. Input: zipBase64 or zipPath (sandbox).

has.description: Entry names that must be present (exact).

maxEntries.description: The archive must hold at most this many entries.

maxUncompressedBytes.description: Sum of the declared uncompressed sizes must not exceed this.

method.description: Every entry must use this method.

minEntries.description: The archive must hold at least this many entries.

check.description: CI assertions evaluated over the report: deterministic, epoch-timestamps, canonical-order, utf8-names, no-data-descriptor, canonical-layout, no-zip64, zip64, no-encryption, no-symlinks, safe-names, no-duplicates, no-diagnostics, store-only, deflate-only. Result: `checks[]` + `checksPassed`.

fields.description: Dot-path projection applied after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); array segments map over elements; unmatched paths are reported in _meta.unmatchedFields.

limits.description: Override zipnative's named security bounds for this call (CWE-400 / CWE-409 guards). Every key is optional; absent keys keep the engine defaults (maxEntries 100000, maxEntryUncompressedSize 1 GiB, maxTotalUncompressedSize 8 GiB, maxCompressionRatio 1024, maxNameBytes 4096, maxExtraFieldBytes 65535, maxCommentBytes 65535, maxCentralDirectoryBytes 256 MiB). Values above the operator ceilings (ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES, ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES) are refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise a bound for trusted input only.

maxCompressionRatio.description: Maximum declared uncompressed/compressed ratio for entries >= 1 KiB compressed (zip-bomb guard).

maxEntryUncompressedSize.description: Maximum decompressed size of one entry, bytes.

maxExtraFieldBytes.description: Maximum extra-field block length in bytes.

maxTotalUncompressedSize.description: Maximum total decompressed size across an extraction, bytes.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine diagnostic (prepended data, duplicate name, name mismatch, …) to a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of reporting it.

validate.description: 'eager' (default) cross-checks every local header and the overlap table up front — hostile shapes are refused here; 'lazy' defers to first read (cheaper on huge archives).

verbosity.description: 'summary' returns only the scalar verdict fields (drops arrays and payloads) — the token-frugal form.

zipBase64.description: The archive bytes as base64 (exactly once; a data: URI prefix is tolerated). Exclusive with zipPath. Decoded size ≤ 128 MiB.

zipPath.description: Relative path of an archive inside the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (no absolute paths, no '..'; container extensions only: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64. Lets a create/modify → verify/extract chain avoid re-sending the bytes.

name: inspect_zip

outputSchema.description: Structured archive report (the zipnative inspect --json shape). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

canonicalLayout.description: summary only: buffered (no data descriptor) layout.

checksPassed.description: Present when check / assert was supplied: true when every assertion holds.

determinism.description: `deterministic` = reproducible (epoch timestamps + canonical order + UTF-8 flags); `canonicalLayout` = the buffered layout (no data descriptors) — a streamed archive is reproducible but not canonical.

diagnosticCount.description: summary only: number of distinct diagnostics.

diagnosticCounts.description: Number of diagnostics received per code (counts every occurrence, including de-duplicated ones).

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal conformance concerns the engine raised while parsing or writing (de-duplicated by code + entry, at most 200). Empty for a clean archive. Codes: ZIP_PREPENDED_DATA, ZIP_MULTIPLE_EOCD, ZIP_NAME_MISMATCH, ZIP_UNICODE_PATH_CONFLICT, ZIP_INVALID_UTF8_NAME, ZIP_DUPLICATE_NAME, ZIP_EXTRA_FIELD_MALFORMED, ZIP_ZIP64_EXTRA_IGNORED, ZIP_TIMESTAMP_NOT_PINNED, ZIP_NONDETERMINISTIC_CODEC, ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: Present (true) when more than 200 distinct diagnostics were dropped from `diagnostics`.

isZip64.description: A Zip64 end-of-central-directory record is present.

prependedData.description: SFX-style prefix before the first local header (offsets shifted).

unsafeNameCount.description: Names sanitizeEntryPath() refuses (traversal, absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, ADS, device names).

title: Inspect archive (facts, determinism verdict, CI checks)
